manaNeeded: {1} if you have discarded and/or cycled exactly two cards
notablePrerequisites: You have discarded and/or cycled at least two cards this turn.
description:
Cast Hollow One from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding one mana of any color.
Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Humility removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded and/or cycled three or more cards, this combo nets infinite colored mana.
